{
  "candidate": "cand_0003",
  "headline": "Switch the lever to DETERMINISTIC in-body WRITE guards the API does not enforce (cancel-flown refusal + payment-method-count refusal) — the POWER move the gate asked for — alongside the proven-safe pricing/return/selection edits, so the fix fires regardless of the mid-tier model's compliance.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Wrong-reservation targeting", "detail": "User names a trip by route/date with no reservation id; agent anchors on the FIRST id from get_user_details (e.g. UM3OG5 SEA->DFW) and never locates the matching one (FQ8APE NY->ORD), so every downstream write diverges. In task 22 it also duplicated the passenger. Task 8: never resolves the 'same flight I took on May 10' reservation (WUNA5K->HAT271) and menu-picks, so the stochastic user sometimes lands on the wrong flight (HAT139, 1 pax).", "tasks": ["17", "22", "8"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Booking payment: stale price + certificate-split", "detail": "Task 25: agent prices from the old reservation's stored fare (299) not the live fare (375), so book_reservation rejects 'does not add up'; recovery is inconsistent (t1 retried, t2 narrated the fix but never re-called). Task 23: three travel certificates must force one reservation per passenger (one cert each); agent instead crams all 3 passengers+3 certs into ONE reservation (t0) which the engine silently accepts but gold rejects, or splits with the wrong gift-card allocation (t1).", "tasks": ["25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Hand-computed charge/refund -> wrong COMMUNICATE", "detail": "Task 11: DB write correct, but agent hand-computes the refund from a single-passenger fare and forgets the x3 passenger multiplier, telling the user 5548 instead of the gold 5244. The engine already computes the exact delta and discards it.", "tasks": ["11"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Unauthorized cancel of an already-flown reservation", "detail": "Task 37-t2: agent cancels NQNU5R whose segments (2024-05-13/14) are before the current date 2024-05-15 (already flown); policy forbids it (requires transfer), the API does NOT enforce it, and the cancel corrupts the DB. t0 did it right (transfer) and scored 1.0.", "tasks": ["37"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Narrate/transfer-without-action (approved write never executed)", "detail": "After confirmation or an out-of-scope detour the agent reports the change done / transfers / is cut off by ###STOP### before issuing the write. Task 12 (t0 transferred, t1 confirmation-gate cut off), 37-t1 (transferred before the upgrade), 25-t2, 23-t2.", "tasks": ["12", "37", "25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "cancel_reservation already-flown + already-cancelled in-body guard", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Replayed on trace args: REFUSES 37 NQNU5R (segment 2024-05-13 < today 2024-05-15); ALLOWS 19 Z7GOZK (05-28) and 23 K1NW8N (05-26/28), the passing cancels. Deterministic — fires regardless of model compliance."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "book_reservation payment-method-count in-body guard (<=1 cert, <=1 cc, <=3 gift)", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Replayed: REFUSES 23-t0 (3 certificates in one reservation) with a split instruction; ALLOWS every gold per-reservation split (1 cert + gifts + cc), task 25 (1 gift+1 cc) and task 8 (1 cert). Enforces policy line 78 the engine ignores."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "book_reservation enriched 'does not add up' / not-found / low-balance errors", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B", "E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "On a bad split prints authoritative total + flights/baggage/insurance breakdown + signed shortfall + 'do NOT reuse stored prices; re-call summing to EXACTLY N'; not-found lists available ids. Only error text changes; passing calls never reach it."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "get_price_quote new read tool (authoritative total from CURRENT prices)", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Reuses the engine's exact pricing (price x pax + 50 x bags + 30 x pax insurance); returns total=375 for task-25's live economy legs (175+200) so the first split is correct. Additive read tool, 15 tools total (<20)."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "update_reservation_flights/baggages return payment_delta/amount_charged/amount_refunded", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Return is the full reservation model_dump() PLUS the signed delta; DB mutation happens in place before the return so the DB hash grader is unaffected. For task 11 the engine delta is 456-5700=-5244 => amount_refunded=5244 = gold COMMUNICATE value."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "get_user_details returns reservations_detail (per-reservation route/date/pax summary)", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Superset of the old User dump built from each reservation's origin/destination + per-segment O->D + status; makes the matching reservation's route visible on the ALWAYS-called first read so the agent stops operating on the first id blind. DB grader reads the DB, not the return."},
    {"id": "E7", "title": "policy: identify-correct-reservation-by-route (+ city->airport, + resolve referenced prior flight, + ask if ambiguous)", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Reinforces the existing 'help locate it using available tools'; points at reservations_detail and get_reservation_details; adds no task literal and flips no currently-correct decision."},
    {"id": "E8", "title": "policy: execute-after-confirm + recover-from-error + finish-before-transfer contract", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "WRONG/RIGHT worked examples; no passing task relied on narrating-without-acting. Secondary (prose) lever for a class with no clean code lever (the stall is ending the turn)."},
    {"id": "E9", "title": "policy: authoritative pricing (get_price_quote first; never stale prices) + one-cert->one-reservation-per-passenger split", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Pairs the get_price_quote tool and the payment-count guard with the stated procedure; the split rule covers task 23's structural decomposition."},
    {"id": "E10", "title": "policy: quote the engine-returned amount, don't hand-compute; change only requested segments", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Points the agent at amount_refunded/amount_charged and warns against the dropped x-passenger multiplier (task 11-t0 5548 vs 5244) and against swapping flights the user did not ask to change (task 11-t2 HAT290->HAT229 broke DB)."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Task 40", "reason": "Documented tau2 user-simulator infra noise (###STOP### + leaked reasoning); instructed not to optimize against it."},
    {"title": "Task 23 exact per-reservation gift-card allocation (both gifts on passenger 1, cc on 2 and 3)", "reason": "That is a task-specific split with no general rule the traces support; a hardcoded allocation would overfit and be rejected by the held-out gate. The payment-count guard + split prose is the general lever; the exact gift-card placement is left to the model."},
    {"title": "A composite split-booking WRITE tool that issues N one-passenger bookings in one call", "reason": "Considered as the strongest cluster-B lever, but it still needs the model to supply the per-passenger payment split, so it does not remove the judgment; and removing the raw book_reservation primitive risks regressing the single-reservation bookings (tasks 8, 25). Deferred in favor of the in-body count guard, which is strictly safe."},
    {"title": "Forcing get_reservation_details before a 'same-flight' booking in code", "reason": "No write tool receives the referenced reservation id, so there is no code choke point to guard; handled via the get_user_details/reservations_detail enrichment + prose."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["parallel diagnostic subagents per cluster with ground-truth write-argument extraction", "DETERMINISTIC in-body WRITE guards enforcing policy rules the API explicitly does not check (the POWER lever)", "guards verified by replaying them on the exact failing AND passing trace arguments", "new read tool for a capability gap", "enriched actionable error text", "enriched return values surfacing engine-computed amounts", "unskippable return enrichment on an always-called read tool", "policy worked examples for a mid-tier reader"]
}
